// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/profile-writes-single-path.test.ts.
// A patch spread straight into the upsert. The comment below MENTIONS the
// single path; the code never calls it. Mention is not use — the guard must
// still flag this (the same prose-as-proof hole the authorization guard had).
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function probeBypassSpread(userId: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>) {
    // These writes go through applyFactWrites, honest.
    await db.policyholderProfile.upsert({
        where: { userId },
        update: { ...patch },
        create: { userId, ...patch },
    })
}
